t: This is 2b Melbury Road, a Grade II listed house in Holland Park, in west London. It was built in 1877 and designed by Sir John Belcher. Belcher was an English architect who went on to become president of the Royal Institute of British Architects. The house sits on a street of individually designed homes, and this one gives you a look at his work from relatively early on, nearly a century and a half after it was built.
